metadata.name: Core Nexus 4K Apex
metadata.description: Adaptive flagship build. Extends 4K Pro with ranked-pool-relative bitrate PSEs using Tukey IQR outlier detection: when ≥4 ranked streams exist the window is Q1−1.5×IQR to Q3+1.5×IQR; for thin pools (1–3 ranked) it falls back to 80%–120% of the ranked min/max; and for new releases (<60 days) with no ranked streams a median-cluster fallback keeps results flowing. HDR and SDR are evaluated separately in the WEB-DL tier. Full 4K Pro ESE stack retained.
metadata.author: Branding-Brevity
